label: Mesonet OILT daily mean wind speed WSPD, dated, 24.3 km, not air temp, not rain, not soil, not humidity, not busy
source: Oklahoma Mesonet monthly .mts daily summaries for OILT (public, keyless HTTP)
endRule: last dated row available at fetch; September 2026 chunk holds Sep 1-8; no fill
wind: disclosed iff WBAD == 0 and not a -996/-999 sentinel; 3997 disclosed, 272 missing
nullRule: wind null iff WBAD != 0 or -996/-999 sentinel; partial-bad days (WBAD > 0, e.g. 2026-07-07 WBAD 25 with filed 1.82) stay missing, never filled; missing stays null, never 0; no WBAD == 0 sentinel rows; no disclosed 0.00 occurred
notFields: WMAX daily maximum in the same filed row is not stitched here; tmax/tmin/tavg/rain/SAVG/HAVG values never copied into this series
notStation: not CUH/KCUH airport ASOS (OK_ASOS); runner-up PERK Perkins (25.7 km) not stitched; never relabeled as Cushing city station
